_meta.source: Single source of truth for BBS vendor facts on California bid forms.
_meta.sibling: obs-form-filler/assets/bbs_vendor_profile.json holds the SAME facts in a flat schema for the OBS packet script. Update BOTH when a cert, address or permit changes.
notes: CERT DISCIPLINE — statewide credit comes ONLY from OSDS DVBE 2009473. San Diego SLBE 17BB1659 and LA County DVBE 10086 are LOCAL certifications and earn no state credit; never cite them for a statewide bid.
BBS is NOT Small Business (SB) certified. Never claim SB status or SB preference on a CA form.
In FEDERAL context BBS is SDVOSB, not DVBE. DVBE is the California term. Do not mix them on one form.
A manufacturer's own GSA or contract vehicle does not authorize BBS to fulfill unless BBS is a named reseller.
